title: Won't tolerate hiring outsiders: CM Abdullah to companies setting up in J&K

ai.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah stated companies in the Union Territory must hire local youth, emphasizing the government's commitment to equitable development and local talent.

facts.claim: companies setting up operations in the Union Territory would have to employ local youth
facts.quote: companies setting up operations in the Union Territory would have to employ local youth

facts.claim: the government won’t tolerate attempts to recruit people from outside
facts.quote: the government won’t tolerate attempts to recruit people from outside

facts.claim: Jammu and Kashmir has no dearth of talent
facts.quote: Jammu and Kashmir has no dearth of talent

facts.claim: young people from Jammu and Kashmir serve in various regiments and across the country
facts.quote: young people from Jammu and Kashmir serve in various regiments and across the country

ai.background_note: Jammu and Kashmir lost statehood in 2019, when it was split into two union territories. The elected government and the Congress say the Centre has not kept its promise to restore it, and protested in July 2026.
